title: 第17章 靠山平事第18章 金铭
content_zh:
邓师父在戏楼熬了一宿，没什么精神，他耷拉着眼皮睨向路沉“呵，你才交了几个钱的束脩？在外头惹了官司，倒有脸来求我？”
路沉噗通跪倒，一言不发。
师娘轻声开口道“这孩子手脚勤快，常替我采买物件，从无怨言。眼下既惹了麻烦，又求到咱门上，总不好真叫人拿去见官，那样武馆脸上也无光。”
邓师父不以为然道
“夫人呐，咱们开的是武馆，不是善堂。他交钱，我教拳，银货两讫的买卖。又不是磕过头递过帖的亲传弟子，难不成往后阿猫阿狗惹了官司，都要武馆替他们擦屁股？”
师娘冷哼道“衙门几时认真缉过凶？不过是随便抓个倒霉的结案。”
邓师父撇嘴道“那也只能怪他时运不济，打伤官差、拒捕逃脱已是重罪，这烂摊子谁愿意沾？要抹平这种事，得填进去多少人情银子？夫人，为这么个穷学徒，不值当！”
“值不值当，岂是光看银钱？”
师娘凤眸一凛，语气中已带了薄怒。
见她如此反应，路沉心底便有了数，或许是因为自己平日殷勤跑腿攒下的情分，又或是深宅寂寞让她对路沉生出几分怜意。
总之，有师娘这座靠山，眼前这关总算能过了。
邓师父是入赘之身，本就矮人一头，见师娘面露愠色，不由得语气一软。
“夫人莫气，你瞧他那身破烂衣裳，哪来的银钱学武？这钱来路不明，保不齐是黑了心的勾当。先让丫鬟去摸个底，若真是清白的，再帮不迟。”
师娘想了想，道“也好，让刘奇陪小高同去。”
小高便是今早唤路沉起床的那个丫鬟。
倒不是师娘不信任她，只是南城那地面向来杂乱，她一个姑娘家独去，难保不遇上些地痞无赖缠扰。让刘奇跟去，多少稳妥些。
丫鬟小高问明路沉住在羊圈街后，便去武馆寻了刘奇，一同来到羊圈街。
二人寻了处茶水摊，向摊主打听路沉的消息。
恰在此时，瞎子打街角转来。
昨夜他们听到路沉的暗号后，都已及时避出城外，直到天亮才悄悄返回。

毕竟捕快要抓的是路沉。
瞎子等人只要不与官差正面遭遇，暂时还算安全。
他心里正嘀咕大哥躲哪儿去了？忽地撞见刘奇在茶摊打问路沉的事。
瞎子独眼闪过抹厉色，也不言语，径自走到摊前坐下，拎起茶壶，给自己斟了碗热茶。
刘奇与丫鬟不识他是谁，只觉得这人透着股阴鸷的寒气，不像善类。
而茶摊老板已是脸色煞白，握着抹布的手微微一抖。
瞎子往那儿一坐，茶摊老板哪敢吐半句对路沉不利的话？
他挤出个笑脸对刘奇道
“路沉这孩子没得说！街坊四邻谁不夸他讲义气、做事厚道？”
刘奇点点头，与小高离开茶摊，继续沿街打听。
所到之处，卖炊饼的老汉、补鞋的匠人、甚至倚在门边的暗娼，无不对路沉交口称赞。
瞎子、拴虎几人始终不远不近地跟着，目光阴沉地扫过每一个答话的街坊。
在羊圈街转悠了一圈后。
刘奇不禁感叹
“我就说嘛，路兄弟是个顶好的人，他定是被冤枉的。瞧瞧，这般人缘，岂是歹徒所能有？”
“是啊，路大哥心善，常帮我们买东西。”
丫鬟小高也轻声应和。
二人回到宅中，将所见所闻如实禀报。
师娘端坐椅上，明艳的脸上浮起一抹笑意，转向邓师父道
“如何？我早说过，路沉是个本分孩子。”

邓师父从鼻子里哼了两声，不屑地别过脸去摆弄茶具，没有接话。
这情形，路沉心里早有数。
content_en:
Master Deng spent the night in the theater and was not very energetic. He looked at Lu Shen with drooped eyelids, "Hey, how much money did you pay to repair? You got into a lawsuit outside, but you have the nerve to beg me?"
Lu Chen fell to his knees without saying a word.
The master's wife said softly, "This child is very diligent and always buys things for me without any complaints. Now that he has caused trouble and begged us, it's hard to really ask someone to take him to see an official. Then the martial arts school will be disgraced."
Master Deng said disapprovingly
"Madam, we are running a martial arts school, not a charity hall. He pays the money, and I teach boxing, and the money is settled. We are not direct disciples who kowtow and hand over the certificate. Is it possible that if cats and dogs get into lawsuits in the future, the martial arts school will wipe their butts for them?"
The teacher's wife snorted coldly, "When has the Yamen ever seriously arrested a murderer? It's just a random case of catching an unlucky person and closing it."
Master Deng curled his lips and said, "That can only be blamed on his bad luck. Injuring an officer and resisting arrest and escaping are already serious crimes. Who wants to get involved in this mess? How many favors and money must be paid to smooth over such a thing? Madam, such a poor apprentice is not worth it!"
"Whether it's worth it or not depends on the money alone?"
The master's eyes narrowed, and there was anger in her tone.
Seeing her reaction like this, Lu Chen knew something in her heart. Perhaps it was because of the affection she had accumulated through her diligent running of errands, or perhaps because of the loneliness at home that made her feel a little pity for Lu Chen.
In short, with the support of my master's wife, I can finally pass this test.
Master Deng was a married woman and was already a dwarf. Seeing the angry look on his wife's face, Master Deng couldn't help but soften his tone.
"Madam, don't be angry. Look at his tattered clothes. Where did he get the money to learn martial arts? The source of the money is unknown, and it is a shady thing to keep it intact. Let the maid go find out first. If he is really innocent, it will not be too late to help."
The teacher's wife thought for a while and said, "Okay, let Liu Qi accompany Xiao Gao."
Xiao Gao was the maid who woke Lu Chen up this morning.
It's not that the master's wife doesn't trust her, it's just that the area in Nancheng is always chaotic. If she goes to a girl's house alone, there's no guarantee that she won't be harassed by some local gangsters. It would be safer to let Liu Qi follow.
After the maid Xiao Gao asked Ming Lu Shen to live on Yangquan Street, she went to the martial arts hall to find Liu Qi and came to Yangquan Street together.
The two found a tea stall and asked the stall owner for news about Lu Chen.
Just at this moment, the blind man came around the corner.
After they heard Lu Shen's signal last night, they all fled outside the city in time and did not return quietly until dawn.
After all, what the police wanted to arrest was Lu Chen.
As long as the blind man and others do not encounter the officials head-on, they are still safe for the time being.
He was wondering where his elder brother was hiding? Suddenly I bumped into Liu Qi asking about Lu Chen at the tea stall.
The blind man's one eye flashed with a stern look, and without saying a word, he walked to the stall and sat down, picked up the teapot, and poured himself a bowl of hot tea.
Liu Qi and the maid didn't know who he was. They just felt that this man had a sinister air and was not like a kind person.
The tea stall owner's face turned pale, and the hand holding the rag shook slightly.
The blind man sat there. How could the tea stall owner dare to say anything unfavorable to Lu Chen?
He forced out a smile and said to Liu Qi
"There's nothing to say about Lu Chen! Who in the neighborhood doesn't praise him for his loyalty and his kindness?"
Liu Qi nodded, left the tea stall with Xiao Gao, and continued to inquire along the street.
Everywhere he went, the old man selling cooking cakes, the craftsman cobbling shoes, and even the prostitute leaning by the door all praised Lu Shen.
The blind man and Shuan Hu followed closely, their eyes darkly scanning every neighbor who answered.
After wandering around Sheepfold Street.
Liu Qi couldn't help but sigh
"Let me just say, Brother Lu is a very good person, and he must have been wronged. Look, how can a gangster have such popularity?"
"Yes, Brother Lu is kind-hearted and often helps us buy things."
The maid Xiao Gao also responded softly.
The two returned to the house and reported truthfully what they saw and heard.
The master's wife sat on the chair, a smile appeared on her bright face, she turned to Master Deng and said
"How? I told you before, Lu Chen is a responsible child. "
Master Deng snorted twice, turned away disdainfully and fiddled with the tea set, without answering.
Lu Chen already knew this situation.
